label: M1_DCM-SchemaRegistry
info:
Backend flows for Schema Registry Management.

════════════════════════════════════════════════
  HOW TO SET YOUR OPENAI API KEY
════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Double-click this flow tab name (DCM-SchemaRegistry)
2. In the Edit Flow panel, click the 'Environment Variables' section
3. Find the variable named: OPENAI_API_KEY
4. Replace PUT_OPENAI_API_KEY_HERE with your real OpenAI API key
   (e.g. sk-proj-abc123...)
5. Click Done, then Deploy

All OpenAI request nodes in this flow use this single key.
Do NOT paste the key anywhere else.

════════════════════════════════════════════════

OpenAI calls use real http request nodes — not simulated.

MongoDB collections used:
  sr_prompts        – prompt records
  sr_test_cases     – saved test cases
  sr_llm_configs    – LLM configuration records
  sr_providers      – multi-model provider records
  sr_local_schemas  – local schema definitions
  sr_mappings       – schema mapping configurations

All responses are sent back to the Dashboard via link-out → dashboard-linkin.

func:
const action = String(msg.type || "");
const auth = msg.auth || {};
const permissions = Array.isArray(auth.permissions) ? auth.permissions : [];
const roles = Array.isArray(auth.roles) ? auth.roles : [];
const requiredPermission = {
  "enhancePrompt": "schema.registry.update",
  "createPrompt": "schema.registry.create",
  "listPrompts": "schema.registry.read",
  "updatePromptCode": "schema.registry.update",
  "deletePrompt": "schema.registry.delete",
  "dryRunPrompt": "schema.registry.read",
  "saveTestCase": "schema.registry.create",
  "listTestCases": "schema.registry.read",
  "deleteTestCase": "schema.registry.delete",
  "updatePrompt": "schema.registry.update",
  "updatePromptStatus": "schema.registry.update",
  "saveLlmConfig": "schema.registry.create",
  "deleteLlmConfig": "schema.registry.delete",
  "saveProvider": "schema.registry.create",
  "deleteProvider": "schema.registry.delete",
  "reorderProvider": "schema.registry.update",
  "startBatchRetransform": "schema.registry.update",
  "cancelBatchRetransform": "schema.registry.update",
  "listLlmConfigs": "schema.registry.read",
  "listProviders": "schema.registry.read",
  "saveLocalSchema": "schema.registry.create",
  "listLocalSchemas": "schema.registry.read",
  "deleteLocalSchema": "schema.registry.delete",
  "saveMapping": "schema.registry.create",
  "listMappings": "schema.registry.read",
  "deleteMapping": "schema.registry.delete",
  "listRemoteSchemas": "schema.registry.read",
  "saveRemoteSchema": "schema.registry.create",
  "deleteRemoteSchema": "schema.registry.delete",
  "listTransformationAudit": "schema.registry.read",
  "exportTransformationAudit": "schema.registry.read",
  "updateTransformationAudit": "schema.registry.update",
  "deleteTransformationAudit": "schema.registry.delete",
  "listLocalSchemaVersions": "schema.registry.read",
  "activateLocalSchemaVersion": "schema.registry.update",
  "validateSampleAsset": "schema.registry.read",
  "listPromptVersions": "schema.registry.read",
  "getLlmUsage": "schema.registry.read",
  "getSystemSettings": "schema.registry.read",
  "setSystemSetting": "schema.registry.update",
  "saveRdfMappingConfig": "schema.registry.update",
  "testRdfMapping": "schema.registry.read",
  "executeHybridTransform": "schema.registry.read",
  "testProviderConnection": "schema.registry.read",
  "retryPromptCodeGeneration": "schema.registry.update",
  "verifyTransformationAuditChain": "schema.registry.read"
}[action] || null;
const isAdmin = auth.role === "admin" || roles.includes("admin");
const allowed = requiredPermission && (
  permissions.includes(requiredPermission) ||
  (isAdmin && permissions.includes("*"))
);
if (allowed) {
  msg._callerUsername = auth.username || "unknown";
  return [msg, null];
}
const reason = requiredPermission ? "missing_permission" : "unmapped_action";
msg.response = {
  action: action || "unknown",
  status: "error",
  ok: false,
  code: "permission_denied",
  error: "permission_denied",
  message: requiredPermission
    ? "Insufficient permissions. Required: " + requiredPermission
    : "Action is not permitted by the backend authorization policy.",
  requiredPermission
};
msg._accessDeniedAudit = {
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  actor: auth.username || "unknown",
  actorId: auth.userId || null,
  area: "schemaRegistry",
  action: "access.denied",
  target: action || "unknown",
  after: { requiredPermission, reason },
  result: "denied",
  source: "rbac"
};
return [null, msg];

── NF-7 MIGRATION: backfill promptId / name / author / status ──
info:
One-shot, idempotent backfill for prompt records created before NF-7.

Maps legacy fields explicitly:
  promptId  <- existing id (each legacy prompt becomes its own version group)
  versionId <- existing id
  name      <- existing name, else "(unnamed) <source> -> <target>"
  author    <- existing author, else "unknown"
  version   <- normalised to semver (1.0 -> 1.0.0)
  status    <- legacy job values ("writing code", "error", "completed")
               remapped onto the lifecycle enum draft|active|deprecated|archived
  generationStatus <- carries the old codeGenerationStatus value

No record is deleted and no existing valid value is overwritten.
Safe to run repeatedly.

name: NF-7 migration: load prompts
NF-7 migration: build backfill
── NF-7: TEST PROVIDER CONNECTION (server-side, sanitised) ──
info:
Resolves a provider by id, decrypts its credential server-side and performs a
minimal request against the provider endpoint.

The API key is never returned to the browser. Only a sanitised result is sent:
  { ok, code, message, providerId, providerName, endpoint (host only), latencyMs, model }

Failure codes: provider_not_found | provider_inactive | credential_missing |
               credential_invalid | provider_unreachable | provider_error

info:
Re-runs code generation for an existing prompt version after the provider
configuration has been corrected. Reuses the normal code-gen chain, so the
lifecycle status is untouched and generationStatus always terminates.

── NF-8: VERIFY AUDIT CHAIN INTEGRITY (read-only) ──
info:
Recomputes the SHA-256 chain over dcm_transformation_audit in sequence
order and reports the genuine result. Detects modified records, broken
previousHash links, and missing or duplicate sequence numbers.

Records written before the chain existed have no recordHash; they are
counted as legacy/unverified and are never reported as verified.
